paragraphs.en: Learning about another culture is like holding up a mirror: it shows us that our own "normal" is just one of many ways to live. That may be the greatest gift of travel.
paragraphs.zh: 認識另一種文化就像舉起一面鏡子：它讓我們明白，自己的「日常」只是眾多生活方式之一。這或許就是旅行最大的禮物。

paragraphs.en: I have a hedgehog named Snowy. Snowy is very clever. Everyone in my family loves Snowy very much.
paragraphs.zh: 我有一隻刺蝟，名叫Snowy。Snowy非常聰明。我們全家人都非常愛Snowy。

paragraphs.en: Every day, Snowy sleeps on my bed all afternoon. Sometimes Snowy also waits for me at the door every day. When I do my homework, Snowy sits quietly beside me like a little guard.
paragraphs.zh: 每天，Snowy都會整個下午都睡在我床上。有時候Snowy也會每天在門口等我。我寫作業時，Snowy會像個小守衛一樣安靜地坐在我旁邊。

paragraphs.en: Taking care of a pet is not always easy, but Snowy gives me so much happiness. A pet is not just an animal - it is family.
paragraphs.zh: 照顧寵物並不總是容易，但Snowy帶給我好多快樂。寵物不只是動物——牠是家人。

paragraphs.en: Few technologies attract as much attention today as space travel. Investment is pouring in, headlines alternate between excitement and alarm, and ordinary people wonder how their lives will change.
paragraphs.zh: 當今很少有科技像太空旅行這樣吸引目光。資金不斷湧入，新聞標題在興奮與警告之間擺盪，一般人則想知道自己的生活將如何改變。

paragraphs.en: The optimistic case is compelling: it could make services cheaper and available to far more people, and it may free workers from dangerous or repetitive tasks. Yet the concerns deserve equal attention - some workers may lose their jobs during the transition, and privacy and safety questions remain unanswered.
paragraphs.zh: 樂觀的理由很有說服力：它可能讓服務更便宜、讓更多人能夠使用，而且它或許能讓工作者擺脫危險或重複性的工作。然而疑慮同樣值得重視——部分工作者可能在轉型過程中失業，而且隱私與安全的疑慮仍未解決。

paragraphs.en: The future of space travel will probably be neither utopia nor disaster. Like every powerful tool before it, its impact will depend less on the technology itself than on the wisdom of the people who use it.
paragraphs.zh: 太空旅行的未來大概既非烏托邦也非災難。如同以往每一項強大的工具，它的影響與其說取決於技術本身，不如說取決於使用它的人是否有智慧。

title: Should We Live without cash? (16)
title_zh: 我們應該過無現金生活嗎？

paragraphs.en: The question of whether we should live without cash has moved from casual conversation into serious public debate. Both sides raise points that deserve honest consideration.
paragraphs.zh: 「我們是否應該過無現金生活」這個問題，已從閒聊話題變成嚴肅的公共辯論。正反雙方都提出了值得認真思考的論點。

paragraphs.en: On one hand, it would push society to try new and creative solutions, and it could save money and resources for everyone involved. On the other hand, critics worry that the costs would fall on those least able to pay, while the change could be hard to enforce fairly.
paragraphs.zh: 一方面，它會促使社會嘗試新穎且有創意的解方，而且它可能為所有相關的人省下金錢與資源。另一方面，批評者擔心成本會落在最無力負擔的人身上，同時這項改變可能難以公平執行。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps the wisest path is neither blind enthusiasm nor automatic rejection, but small, honest experiments: try the idea at a limited scale, measure the results, and let evidence - not slogans - make the final decision.
paragraphs.zh: 也許最明智的路既不是盲目擁抱，也不是直接否決，而是小規模的誠實實驗：在有限範圍內嘗試、衡量結果，讓證據——而不是口號——做出最終決定。

paragraphs.en: I have a cat named Sunny. Sunny is a little shy. Everyone in my family loves Sunny very much.
paragraphs.zh: 我有一隻貓，名叫Sunny。Sunny有點害羞。我們全家人都非常愛Sunny。

paragraphs.en: Every day, Sunny hides my socks under the sofa. Sometimes Sunny also follows me around the house. When I do my homework, Sunny sits quietly beside me like a little guard.
paragraphs.zh: 每天，Sunny都會把我的襪子藏到沙發下。有時候Sunny也會在家裡跟著我到處走。我寫作業時，Sunny會像個小守衛一樣安靜地坐在我旁邊。

paragraphs.en: Taking care of a pet is not always easy, but Sunny gives me so much happiness. A pet is not just an animal - it is family.
paragraphs.zh: 照顧寵物並不總是容易，但Sunny帶給我好多快樂。寵物不只是動物——牠是家人。

paragraphs.en: Few technologies attract as much attention today as virtual reality. Investment is pouring in, headlines alternate between excitement and alarm, and ordinary people wonder how their lives will change.
paragraphs.zh: 當今很少有科技像虛擬實境這樣吸引目光。資金不斷湧入，新聞標題在興奮與警告之間擺盪，一般人則想知道自己的生活將如何改變。

paragraphs.en: The optimistic case is compelling: it opens doors for small companies to compete with giants, and it could help us use resources far more efficiently. Yet the concerns deserve equal attention - privacy and safety questions remain unanswered, and the technology is still expensive and imperfect.
paragraphs.zh: 樂觀的理由很有說服力：它讓小公司也有機會與巨頭競爭，而且它可能幫助我們更有效率地使用資源。然而疑慮同樣值得重視——隱私與安全的疑慮仍未解決，而且這項技術仍然昂貴且不完美。

paragraphs.en: The future of virtual reality will probably be neither utopia nor disaster. Like every powerful tool before it, its impact will depend less on the technology itself than on the wisdom of the people who use it.
paragraphs.zh: 虛擬實境的未來大概既非烏托邦也非災難。如同以往每一項強大的工具，它的影響與其說取決於技術本身，不如說取決於使用它的人是否有智慧。

paragraphs.en: I have a turtle named Lucky. Lucky is quiet and gentle. Everyone in my family loves Lucky very much.
paragraphs.zh: 我有一隻烏龜，名叫Lucky。Lucky安靜又溫柔。我們全家人都非常愛Lucky。

paragraphs.en: Every day, Lucky follows me around the house. Sometimes Lucky also hides my socks under the sofa. When I do my homework, Lucky sits quietly beside me like a little guard.
paragraphs.zh: 每天，Lucky都會在家裡跟著我到處走。有時候Lucky也會把我的襪子藏到沙發下。我寫作業時，Lucky會像個小守衛一樣安靜地坐在我旁邊。

paragraphs.en: Taking care of a pet is not always easy, but Lucky gives me so much happiness. A pet is not just an animal - it is family.
paragraphs.zh: 照顧寵物並不總是容易，但Lucky帶給我好多快樂。寵物不只是動物——牠是家人。

title: Why Playing Chess Is Good for You (16)

paragraphs.en: In our busy modern life, many people are rediscovering playing chess. It requires no special talent, and almost anyone can begin this week.
paragraphs.zh: 在忙碌的現代生活中，許多人重新發現了下棋的好處。它不需要特殊天分，幾乎任何人本週就能開始。

paragraphs.en: The benefits are greater than most people expect. First, it helps you focus better at work or school. Second, it gives your brain a healthy break from screens. Research also suggests that it strengthens your heart and improves your sleep.
paragraphs.zh: 它的好處比多數人想像的更多。首先，它能幫助你在工作或課業上更專注。其次，它能讓大腦健康地遠離螢幕休息。研究也指出，它能強化心臟並改善睡眠。

paragraphs.en: You do not need to be perfect at it - you only need to start. Try playing chess for just fifteen minutes tomorrow, and let the habit grow from there.
paragraphs.zh: 你不需要做得完美——只需要開始。明天先試著下棋十五分鐘，讓習慣從那裡慢慢成長。

title: Why Cycling Is Good for You (16)
title_zh: 為什麼騎自行車對你有益

paragraphs.en: In our busy modern life, many people are rediscovering cycling. It requires no special talent, and almost anyone can begin this week.
paragraphs.zh: 在忙碌的現代生活中，許多人重新發現了騎自行車的好處。它不需要特殊天分，幾乎任何人本週就能開始。

paragraphs.en: The benefits are greater than most people expect. First, it reduces stress after a long day. Second, it gives your brain a healthy break from screens. Research also suggests that it teaches you patience and discipline.
paragraphs.zh: 它的好處比多數人想像的更多。首先，它能減輕一整天下來的壓力。其次，它能讓大腦健康地遠離螢幕休息。研究也指出，它能培養你的耐心與自律。

paragraphs.en: You do not need to be perfect at it - you only need to start. Try cycling for just fifteen minutes tomorrow, and let the habit grow from there.
paragraphs.zh: 你不需要做得完美——只需要開始。明天先試著騎自行車十五分鐘，讓習慣從那裡慢慢成長。

paragraphs.en: Last summer, I visited Kyoto with my brother. We went there by bus. The trip took about 9 hours, but I was too excited to feel tired.
paragraphs.zh: 去年夏天，我和哥哥一起去了京都。我們搭巴士前往，路程大約花了9個小時，但我興奮得一點也不覺得累。

paragraphs.en: On the first day, we saw a famous museum. It was even more beautiful than the photos online. Later, we tried the famous local seafood. The taste was amazing, and we ordered more.
paragraphs.zh: 第一天，我們參觀了一間著名的博物館。它比網路上的照片更美。之後我們品嚐了當地著名的海鮮，味道好極了，我們又多點了一些。

paragraphs.en: Time passed so quickly. Before we left, we bought some small gifts for our friends. I will never forget that wonderful trip. I hope I can visit Kyoto again someday.
paragraphs.zh: 時間過得好快。離開前，我們買了一些小禮物送給朋友。我永遠不會忘記那趟美好的旅程。希望有一天我能再訪京都。

paragraphs.en: Last Saturday was a rainy day, so we could not go out as planned. I felt a little sad at first, looking out of the window.
paragraphs.zh: 上週六是下雨的一天，我們無法照計畫出門。一開始我望著窗外，覺得有點難過。

paragraphs.en: Then my classmates had a great idea: we could write letters together at home. Later, we also clean my room. The living room was full of laughter all afternoon.
paragraphs.zh: 接著同學們想到一個好主意：我們可以一起在家寫信。後來我們還整理房間。整個下午客廳都充滿了笑聲。

paragraphs.en: That day I learned something important: a good day does not depend on the weather. It depends on the people you spend it with.
paragraphs.zh: 那天我學到重要的一課：美好的一天不取決於天氣，而取決於和你共度的人。

paragraphs.en: During the new year holiday, I visited Tainan with my sister. We went there by high-speed rail. The trip took about 6 hours, but I was too excited to feel tired.
paragraphs.zh: 新年假期期間，我和姊姊一起去了台南。我們搭高鐵前往，路程大約花了6個小時，但我興奮得一點也不覺得累。

paragraphs.en: On the first day, we saw a huge park. It was even more beautiful than the photos online. Later, we tried the famous local seafood. The taste was amazing, and we ordered more.
paragraphs.zh: 第一天，我們參觀了一座大公園。它比網路上的照片更美。之後我們品嚐了當地著名的海鮮，味道好極了，我們又多點了一些。

paragraphs.en: Time passed so quickly. Before we left, we bought some small gifts for our friends. Just thinking about it still makes me smile. I hope I can visit Tainan again someday.
paragraphs.zh: 時間過得好快。離開前，我們買了一些小禮物送給朋友。光是回想起來仍讓我微笑。希望有一天我能再訪台南。

paragraphs.en: This year, I decided to learn to skate. My mother offered to teach me. At first, I thought it would be easy, but I was wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 今年，我決定要學溜冰。媽媽主動說要教我。一開始我以為很簡單，但我錯了。

paragraphs.en: In the first week, I made many mistakes and almost gave up. My mother smiled and said, "Everyone starts badly. Just keep practicing." So I practiced a little every day.
paragraphs.zh: 第一週，我犯了很多錯，差點放棄。媽媽微笑著說：「每個人一開始都做不好，繼續練習就對了。」於是我每天練習一點點。

paragraphs.en: After about 2 weeks, something wonderful happened - I could really skate! Now I understand: if you practice every day, nothing is impossible.
paragraphs.zh: 大約2週後，美好的事發生了——我真的會溜冰了！現在我明白：只要每天練習，沒有什麼是不可能的。

paragraphs.en: I have a turtle named Momo. Momo is naughty but cute. Everyone in my family loves Momo very much.
paragraphs.zh: 我有一隻烏龜，名叫Momo。Momo調皮但可愛。我們全家人都非常愛Momo。

paragraphs.en: Every day, Momo chases the ball in the living room. Sometimes Momo also follows me around the house. When I do my homework, Momo sits quietly beside me like a little guard.
paragraphs.zh: 每天，Momo都會在客廳追球。有時候Momo也會在家裡跟著我到處走。我寫作業時，Momo會像個小守衛一樣安靜地坐在我旁邊。

paragraphs.en: Taking care of a pet is not always easy, but Momo gives me so much happiness. A pet is not just an animal - it is family.
paragraphs.zh: 照顧寵物並不總是容易，但Momo帶給我好多快樂。寵物不只是動物——牠是家人。

title: Why Cooking At Home Is Good for You (12)
title_zh: 為什麼在家做菜對你有益

paragraphs.en: In our busy modern life, many people are rediscovering cooking at home. It requires no special talent, and almost anyone can begin this week.
paragraphs.zh: 在忙碌的現代生活中，許多人重新發現了在家做菜的好處。它不需要特殊天分，幾乎任何人本週就能開始。

paragraphs.en: The benefits are greater than most people expect. First, it helps you focus better at work or school. Second, it builds confidence step by step. Research also suggests that it costs almost nothing to start.
paragraphs.zh: 它的好處比多數人想像的更多。首先，它能幫助你在工作或課業上更專注。其次，它能一步步建立自信。研究也指出，開始幾乎不需要任何花費。

paragraphs.en: You do not need to be perfect at it - you only need to start. Try cooking at home for just fifteen minutes tomorrow, and let the habit grow from there.
paragraphs.zh: 你不需要做得完美——只需要開始。明天先試著在家做菜十五分鐘，讓習慣從那裡慢慢成長。
